reviews.title: Pay to Save
reviews.text: This app should not be labeled as a “Free” app in the app store. You can use the free version to see what your photos might look like in a collage — on a screen, inside the app. But you won’t be allowed to save your work unless you pay to do so. This is new — (so maybe some of the high 5-star reviews actually pertain to the old free version that allowed the user to save a collage. Maybe.). I enjoyed this [free] PicCollage app for several years, although I don’t use it often. I could load my photos into one of their grids, save it to my photos library. Later I  could post my collage to Facebook.  I never paid for the advanced version so my collages always had a notation on them “ Created using PicCollage” or something to that effect. That’s fine with me. However, today I made a collage … but there was no way to save it to my photos library. As a “last resort” I tried to save it as a screen shot. The resulting photo in my library just had an ad for the paid version. The developers apparently changed the app. ensuring that no one could actually use the app unless they paid for the advanced version — or maybe there’s a subscription option (I don’t know). Oh, well. I’ll pay for some advanced apps… but, like I said, I don’t use it so  often that it justifies a purchase. [Naturally this 1-star review probably won’t qualify to be on the visible scroll-and-read review roll. ]

reviews.title: Was Satisfied Until …
reviews.text: I purchased the VIP Level membership, and I was enjoying the app until today. I started receiving 90% photo backgrounds that had watermarks on them. The main reason I purchased the app was to remove the watermarks. This is the very first time I’ve ever had to reach out to customer service for this app error, and the agent emailed me asking me to go through a ton of work, including reactivating my account! I’m still a paid VIP Member for 7 more months, so I’m not sure what they want me to reactivate? Absolutely ridiculous! I was a loyal customer to them and even renewed my membership once, but it’s cancelled now, because I don’t feel that it is my job to have to spend my time emailing back and forth with them to resolve this! This is an issue the company needs to resolve after I paid for the VIP membership. I was also concerned that I was going to get charged again, so I’m done with this one. There are too many photo editing apps out there that I feel are better, so I’ll take my business there. I hope you have better luck if you decide to purchase it.

reviews.title: Quality has plummeted
reviews.text:
I’ve loved this app for years and have paid for the annual membership because the extra features were worth it. Unfortunately, over the past year the quality has taken a noticeable dive.

The app regularly freezes or crashes in the middle of creating, which causes me to lose my work entirely—this literally just happened today (1/2/26). Even when I do save, it often doesn’t keep the most recent version. Trying to match background colors either crashes the app altogether or gives results that don’t match what I selected.

These aren’t small inconveniences—they’re constant disruptions that make the app unreliable to use. If the performance and quality don’t improve, this will be my last year renewing my membership. (And no, I won't be sending an email or screenshot to your team because you all are well aware of the unfortunate recent downfalls).
